1337.1.1.description:
Walk through all the CLI SHOW commands

[Log-derived analysis] Broad CLI robustness / soak walk. Saves the running configuration, then walks the full SHOW command tree, issuing each command and sub-command syntax variant, periodically checking the device for exceptions and recording memory consumption to detect leaks. Verifies that exercising every CLI SHOW command causes no crashes or exceptions, that the configuration is restored unchanged on tear-down, and that no memory leak is seen across the walk.
